decision_rule: A check is robustly top-ranked only when its minimum fixed-measure net VOI is strictly greater than every other check's maximum. Otherwise emit UNCERTAIN_MODEL_DEPENDENT_RANKING.
fallback_rule: On an uncertain ranking, choose the action in {no_check} union admissible checks with minimum worst-case net-VOI regret across the frozen credal set; ties prefer lower cost, then lexical id. This is separate from the fixed-measure envelope.
scope: finite authored likelihood models only; no live calibration or GUI result
